input.command:
cd /tmp/obench-cell-bt6yyt8l/bench_opencode_trig-read-lines_osl1lle6 && sed -i 's/year.strip(), int(copies)/int(year), int(copies)/' catalog/books.py \
&& sed -i 's/MAX_BORROWED = 3/MAX_BORROWED = 5/' catalog/members.py \
&& sed -i 's/days_late + DAILY_FEE/days_late * DAILY_FEE/' catalog/fees.py \
&& sed -i 's/\[-n - 1:\]/[-n:]/' catalog/inventory.py \
&& sed -i 's/catalog.nonexistent/catalog.text/' catalog/search.py \
&& sed -i 's/        Book("1984", "Orwell", 1949, 2),/&\n        Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1),/' catalog/factory.py \
&& python3 -m unittest 2>&1 | tail -15
